plan.title: L1 Highlight and Revised Bid Savings

steps.note: Start a multi-stage event creation flow for the RFQ.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Create multiple line items so per-line lowest-price behavior can be exercised.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule required for publishing.
Invite two vendors so their quoted prices can be compared.
Publish the RFQ before collecting bids.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Record the first vendor's initial bid, which will be revised later.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Record a competing vendor bid for comparison.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a revision from the first vendor at a lower price to create a previous-bid comparison.
Confirm the revised bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the per-vendor line-item comparison is displayed.
Verify that both vendor responses are visible on the buyer's RFQ Responses view.
Check that the Responses view exposes the L1 designation, although the catalog cannot verify its green styling or per-cell placement.
Open the comparison grid to obtain the closest catalog assertion for lowest-price ordering per line.
Verify that rankings follow the lowest RFQ amount across the line items.
